title: Boundary-layer asymptotics for Gaussian-smoothed singular measures
summary: We study the small-noise asymptotics of Euclidean heat regularizations of probability measures supported on manifolds with corners. Near a boundary or corner stratum, the relevant regime is a conical boundary layer in which the observation point approaches the stratum at the same scale as the Gaussian smoothing parameter. After rescaling this layer, the support is replaced to leading order by its inward tangent cone. We prove a two-term expansion for the heat-regularized density in this regime.
